decisive_items: lung cancer with metastatic disease to the brain and myocardium
Well-circumscribed 2.8 × 2.6-cm mass located in the left ventricular mid-apical anteroseptum
Large pericardial effusion with signs of impending cardiac tamponade
response.rationale: Patient has known myocardial metastasis and a discrete LV mass; pericardial effusion is a consequence. Angiography excludes ACS, and tamponade alone does not explain the mass or ECG changes.

rejected.why: Tamponade is a complication of the effusion but not the underlying cause; mass and metastatic history point to myocardial metastasis.
Angiography shows nonobstructive disease with no acute occlusion; troponin elevation is stable and not diagnostic of ACS.
